<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Convert binary to Gray code
        function automatic [3:0] bin_to_gray;
            input [3:0] bin;
            begin
                bin_to_gray = {bin[3], bin[3]^bin[2], bin[2]^bin[1], bin[1]^bin[0]};
            end
        endfunction
        // Convert Gray code to binary
        function automatic [3:0] gray_to_bin;
            input [3:0] gray;
            begin
                gray_to_bin[3] = gray[3];
                gray_to_bin[2] = gray[3] ^ gray[2];
                gray_to_bin[1] = gray[3] ^ gray[2] ^ gray[1];
                gray_to_bin[0] = gray[3] ^ gray[2] ^ gray[1] ^ gray[0];
            end
        endfunction
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(DEPTH, WIDTH) ram_inst(
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(winc & !wfull),
            .waddr(waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .renc(rinc & !rempty),
            .raddr(raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
        // Write pointer logic
        reg [3:0] waddr_bin;
        reg [3:0] wptr;
        reg [3:0] wptr_buff;
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 4'd0;
                wptr <= 4'd0;
                wptr_buff <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                if (winc && !wfull) begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                    wptr <= bin_to_gray(waddr_bin);
                end
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        // Read pointer logic
        reg [3:0] raddr_bin;
        reg [3:0] rptr;
        reg [3:0] rptr_buff;
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 4'd0;
                rptr <= 4'd0;
                rptr_buff <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                    rptr <= bin_to_gray(raddr_bin);
                end
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        // Synchronize read pointer to write clock domain
        reg [3:0] rptr_syn;
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        // Synchronize write pointer to read clock domain
        reg [3:0] wptr_syn;
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        // Full and empty signal generation
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr_syn[3], rptr_syn[2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr_syn);
    </implementation>
</module>
